text: Artificial intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to perform tasks that normally require human intelligence, such as learning, reasoning, and decision-making. Machine learning is a key part of AI: computers learn from data instead of following fixed instructions. Deep learning, a more advanced form, uses artificial neural networks to handle complex tasks like image and speech recognition. Today, AI is part of daily life. It suggests films on streaming platforms, powers voice assistants on our phones, helps doctors diagnose illnesses, and improves navigation apps. In short, AI is no longer science fiction—it is already shaping the way we live and work.
